executiveSummary: All six functional requirements and all five user stories for iteration 000001 are fully satisfied. Two minor gaps (missing lock files, undocumented cross-package dotenvx prerequisite) were identified and resolved inline.
minorObservations: Lock files (bun.lock and uv.lock) were not committed. Resolved: both generated and added to the repository.
Worker dotenvx invocation implicitly requires gateway to be installed first (gateway/node_modules/.bin/dotenvx). Resolved: prerequisite note added to README.
Cosmetic: worker/.env.example lacked a trailing newline. Left as-is (no code impact).
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Iteration 000001 fully meets Phase 1 scope. Both actionable gaps resolved inline. No further changes needed for this iteration.
refactorPlan: No refactoring required. A dedicated refactor review is recommended at the start of Phase 2+ when gateway/src/index.ts is expected to grow beyond its current single-file structure.

appliedRecommendations.action: Generated gateway/bun.lock via `bun install` and worker/uv.lock via `uv sync`; both added to repository.

appliedRecommendations.action: Added a callout note to README.md Prerequisites section clarifying that gateway must be installed before using the dotenvx CLI for the worker.
